completion_criteria.criterion: Freeze cutoff, three detailed priority cases and all fourteen parent-case triage entries, with exclusions and reasons visible.

For each detailed priority case, answer the public decision question with claim-level authoritative receipts, evidence dates, contrary evidence, limitations and one qualified public-assessment disposition.

Separate adopted obligations, proposals, management reports, historical findings and interpretation; report selected GA80/GA81 coverage and unresolved instrument searches without universal compliance claims.
Classify every material monetary reference by source, unit, period, proposal/adoption/actual status and embedded versus incremental treatment; publish no unsupported savings or additive totals.
Review every material conclusion and recommendation by a reviewer other than its author, identifying agent review and unresolved disagreements explicitly.
Regenerate the public assessment, case receipts and leadership brief reproducibly from versioned public inputs; preserve prior baselines and resolve critical release contradictions.

Close feasible public-research gaps through documented searches and source comparison; retain unavailable or inconclusive evidence as explicit limits, with exact blocked conclusions and next public or optional operational evidence.
Record a concrete next decision, proposed responsible role and reopening trigger for every detailed case and screening disposition; retain adverse and no-change conclusions.
Confirm zero restricted records disclosed, zero unsupported savings claims, zero known double-counted amounts and zero unresolved critical authority or current-status errors in release claims.

coverage_boundary: Three detailed public assessments and fourteen visible parent screening/triage entries; not fourteen operational audits, universal mission coverage or exhaustive GA80/GA81 compliance coverage.
financial_policy: No positive dollar target. Unknown differs from zero. Public assessment dispositions do not advance F03 states or authorize savings language.
historical_records_policy: Preserve all prior candidate states, source qualifications, evidence requests, operational gates and benefit ledgers.
release_owner_role: Project research release maintainer, not an accepted UN operational owner
